m: द्व mfn. original stem of द्वि, q.v. (nom. acc. du. m. द्व, or द्वौ fn. द्वे; instr. dat. abl. द्वाभ्याम् gen. loc. द्वयोस्) two, RV. &c. &c.
both (with अपि, Ragh. xii, 93)
loc. द्वयोस् in two genders (masc. and fem.) or in two numbers (sing. and pl.), Gr.; L.
द्व [cf. द्वा and द्वि; Zd. dva; Gk. δύο, δύω and δι = δϝι; Lat. duō̆ and bi = द्वि; Lith. du, dvi; Slav. dǔva; Goth. tvai, tva &c.]
द्वंद n. (corrupted fr. द्वंद्व) pair, couple, L.
द्वंद m. a clock or plate on which the hours are struck, W.
a: द्वंदः — A plate on which hours are struck. --दं A pair, couple.

m: द्वंद्वादि-कोश m. N. of a dictionary.
द्वंद्वालाप m. dialogue between two persons, private conversation, Pañc.
द्वंद्वाराम mfn. liking to live in couples, MBh.
द्वंद्वातीत mfn. gone beyond or freed from opposites (see above), W.
द्वंद्वी-√ भू to become joined in couples, BhP.; to engage in single combat, MBh.; to hesitate or be doubtful (cf. ˚द्व-भूत).

a: द्वंद्वीभूत — a. Engaged in a single combat.

m: द्वंद्व n. (the repeated nom. of द्व) pair, couple, male and female, TS.; Br.; MBh.; Kāv. &c. (˚अम् ind., ˚द्वे ind., or ˚द्वेन ind. by two, face to face, secretly)
a pair of opposites (e.g. heat and cold, joy and sorrow &c.), Up.; Mn.; MBh.; R. &c.
strife, quarrel, contest, fight (esp. between two persons, a duel), MBh.; R.; Hit.
stronghold, fortress, L.

द्वंद्व m. (scil. समास; rarely n.) a copulative compound (or any c˚ in which the members if uncompounded would be in the same case and connected by the conjunction, ‘and’, cf. देवता-, नक्षत्र-), Pāṇ. ii, 2, 29; 4, 2
द्वंद्व m. N. of sev. Ekāhas, KātyŚr.
the sign of the zodiac Gemini, Gol.
(in music) a kind of measure
a species of disease, a complication of two disorders, a compound affection of two humours, L.
a: द्वंद्वं — [द्वौ द्वौ सहाभिव्यक्तौ; cf. P. VIII. 1. 15. Sk.] 1 A pair, couple. --2 A couple of animals (including even men) of different sexes, i. e. male and female; द्वंद्वानि भावं क्रियया विवव्रुः Ku. 3. 35; Me. 45; न चेदिदं द्वंद्वमयोजयिष्यत् Ku. 7. 66; R. 1. 40; Ś. 2. 14, 7. 27. --3 A couple of opposite conditions or qualities, (such as सुख and दुःख, शीत and उष्ण); बलवती हि द्वंद्वानां प्रवृतिः K. 135; द्वंद्वैरयोजयच्चेमाः सुखदुःखादिभिः प्रजाः Ms. 1. 26; 6. 81; सर्वर्त्तुनिर्वृतिकरे निवसन्नुपैति न द्वंद्वदुःखमिह किंचिदकिंचनोऽपि Śi. 4. 64. --4 A strife, contention, quarrel, dispute, fight. --5 A duel. --6 Doubt, uncertainty. --7 A fortress, stronghold. --8 A secret. --द्वः 1 (In gram.) One of the four principal kinds of compounds, in which two or more words are joined together which, if not compounded, would stand in the same case and be connected by the copulative conjunction ‘and’; चार्थे द्वंद्वः P. II. 2. 29; द्वंद्वः सामासिकस्य च Bg. 10. 33. --2 A kind of disease. --3 The sign Gemini of the zodiac. --Comp. --चर, चारिन् a. living in couples. (--m.) the ruddy goose; दयिता द्वंद्वचरं पतत्त्रिणं R. 8. 56, 16. 63. --ज a. {1} produced from morbid affection of two humours. {2} arising from a quarrel {3} arising from a couple. --भावः antagonism, discord. --भिन्नं separation of the sexes. --भूत a. {1} forming a couple. {2} doubtful, uncertain. --मोहः trouble caused by doubt. --युद्धं a duel, a single combat.

m: द्वंद्व—भाव m. antagonism, discord, Ṛtus.
द्वंद्व—भूत mfn. become doubtful, irresolute, uncertain of (loc.), MBh. i, 1867 (v.l. ˚द्वी-भ्˚).
द्वंद्व—भिन्न n. separation of the sexes, W.

a: द्वंद्वशः — ind. Two by two, in pairs or couples.

m: द्वंद्व—शस् ind. two by two, in couples, MBh.; R. &c.
द्वंद्व—चर (L.) and द्वंद्व—चारिन् (Ragh.), m. ‘living in couples’, the ruddy goose, Anas Casarca.
द्वंद्व—दुःख n. pain arising from opposite alternations (as heat and cold &c.), Śiś. iv, 64.
द्वंद्व—ज mfn. proceeding from a pair or from discord or from a morbid affection of two humours, W.
द्वंद्व—लक्षण-वाद m. N. of wk.
द्वंद्वम् (अम्), ind., by two, face to face, secretly
द्वंद्व—मोह m. trouble excited by doubt, MW.
द्वंद्व—सहिष्णु-ता f. (Vedānt.)
द्वंद्व-सहिष्णु-त्व n. (MBh.) ability to support opposites (as happiness and misery &c.)
द्वंद्व—सम्प्रहार m. = -युद्ध, Uttarar.
द्वंद्व—विचार m. N. of wk.
द्वंद्व—योधिन् mfn. fighting in couples or by single combat, BhP.
द्वंद्व—युद्ध n. duel, single combat, W.
द्वंद्व—युद्ध—वर्णन n. N. of 41st ch. of GaṇP. ii.
द्वंद्वे (ए), ind., by two, face to face, secretly
द्वंद्वेन (एन), ind., by two, face to face, secretly
द्वंद्विन् mfn. forming a couple, ŚBr.
opposed to one another, contradictory, antagonistic, Prab.
a: द्वंद्विन् — a. 1 Forming a couple. --2 Opposed to one another (as सुख and दुःख), contradictory. --3 Quarrelsome, contentious.

m: द्वक mfn. du. two and two, twofold, RV. x, 59, 9.

a: द्वय — a. (यी f.) Twofold, double, of two kinds or sorts; अनुपेक्षणे द्वयी गतिः Mu. 3; Bh. 2. 104 v. l.; sometimes used in pl. also; see Śi. 3. 57. --यं 1 Pair, couple, brace; (usually at the end of comp.); द्वितयेन द्वयमेव संगतं R. 8. 6; 1. 19; 3. 8; 4. 4. --2 Two fold nature, duplicity. --3 Untruthfulness. --4 (In gram.) The masculine and feminine gender. --यी A pair, couple. --Comp. --अतिग a. one whose mind is freed from the influence of the two bad qualities रजस् and तमस्, a saint or a virtuous man. --आत्मक a. of a twofold nature. --वादिन् a. doubletongued, insincere. --हीन a. of the neuter gender.
